name: Melchizedek
description: Priest living at the time of the Patriarchs

points: Melchizedek king of Salem brought forth bread and wine; Salem goes into Shalom, peace, so he is the king of peace, and he was the priest of the Most High God.

note.label: Genesis 14: The War of the Kings and Melchizedek

points: The Lord hath sworn and will not repent, thou art a priest forever after the order of Melchizedek. Christ is the priest forever after this order.

note.label: Psalm 110: Sit Thou at My Right Hand
